# ONNX Runtime Web

Version: 1.22.0. Locally hosted WASM-only runtime; no camera data is sent to external services.

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web/v/1.22.0
- Assets: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@1.22.0/dist/
- Source and MIT license: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.22.0

Use one WASM thread for compatibility without cross-origin isolation. Ship the .mjs and .wasm files together with the same version.
